scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run test:cdn-path-contract && pnpm run test:gateway-routing && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.deploy: pnpm run test:cdn-path-contract && pnpm run test:gateway-routing && cd artifacts/cf-worker && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cdn: pnpm run test:cdn-path-contract && pnpm run test:gateway-routing && pnpm --filter @workspace/cf-worker exec wrangler deploy --config ../../workers/afucloud-cdn/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:gateway: pnpm run test:gateway-routing && pnpm --filter @workspace/cf-worker exec wrangler deploy --config ../../workers/api-gateway/wrangler.toml
